organizationCreated.subject: Your organization "{organizationName}" is ready
organizationCreated.previewText: {organizationName} is ready. Invite your team and start scheduling shifts.
organizationCreated.heading: Your organization is ready
organizationCreated.greetingAfter: is now set up on {brandName}. You can start inviting teammates and scheduling shifts right away.
organizationCreated.step1Detail: add admins and coordinators so you are not scheduling alone.
organizationCreated.step2Detail: set the times, roles, and how many volunteers you need.
organizationCreated.step3Detail: share your sign-up link and watch the schedule fill in.
organizationCreated.footerNote: You are receiving this because you created an organization on {brandName}.

membershipRequested.subject: New membership request for {organizationName}
membershipRequested.heading: New membership request
membershipRequested.greetingSuffix: Review the request when you have a moment so they know whether they can start volunteering.
membershipRequested.note: Pending requests stay open until an admin approves or rejects them.
membershipRequested.footerNote: You are receiving this because you can review membership requests on {brandName}.

membershipApproved.subject: You're approved for {organizationName}
membershipApproved.previewText: Your membership to {organizationName} has been approved. Browse shifts and sign up when you are ready.
membershipApproved.heading: Welcome aboard
membershipApproved.greetingAfter: has been approved. You can now browse shifts and sign up when something fits your availability.
membershipApproved.step1Detail: make sure your details are up to date.
membershipApproved.step2Detail: find times and roles that work for you.
membershipApproved.step3Detail: join a shift and you are all set.
membershipApproved.footerNote: You are receiving this because your membership request to {organizationName} was approved on {brandName}.

shiftInstanceJoined.subject: {shiftTitle}: {volunteerName} joined
shiftInstanceJoined.heading: Someone joined a shift
shiftInstanceJoined.greeting: Hi {firstName}, a volunteer signed up for a shift you can manage.
shiftInstanceJoined.note: The schedule has already been updated with this volunteer.
shiftInstanceJoined.footerNote: You are receiving this because you can manage shifts on {brandName}.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {brandName} password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: Use the button below to choose a new password for your {brandName} account.
passwordReset.note: If you did not request this password reset, you can ignore this email.
passwordReset.footerNote: You are receiving this because a password reset was requested for your {brandName} account.

accountVerificationOtp.subject: Your {brandName} verification code
accountVerificationOtp.heading: Verify your email
accountVerificationOtp.intro: Use this code to verify your {brandName} account email address.
accountVerificationOtp.note: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.
accountVerificationOtp.footerNote: You are receiving this because this email was used to create an account on {brandName}.
